name: Scheduling Demo (example)
description: Example plugin (opt-in): a benign, paused-by-default daily task whose handler logs a heartbeat, showing the scheduledTasks contribution. Enabling it adds one example row to the scheduler; disabling removes it.
author: cognia-next

scheduledTasks.name: Heartbeat (example)
scheduledTasks.description: Example task: logs a heartbeat once a day to show a plugin-contributed scheduled task. Paused until you resume it.

zh-CN.manifest.name: 定时任务示例（示例）
zh-CN.manifest.description: 示例插件（需手动开启）：一个默认暂停的无害每日任务，其处理函数只记录一次心跳，用于演示 scheduledTasks 贡献。启用后会在调度器中添加一条示例任务，停用即移除。
